Thanks — I took a pass at the evaluation segment and added a slide to the agenda PDF with the proposed gates:
- Gate 1 (T+1 week): baseline quality metrics on a 1k sample (functional checklist + latency)
- Gate 2 (T+3 weeks): production-like eval on a 10k sample; boolean pass/fail on precision thresholds
- Gate 3 (T+6 weeks): rollout readiness (SRE signoff + cost/perf targets)

I'll run Gate 1 expectations in the kickoff and propose owners in the doc. For the data access ask: can Acme provide a 1k sample dataset with labels or a clear acceptance test by Wed 2/24? That lets us stand up an initial eval by the following week.
